about.headline: Your technology partner, from idea to everyday operations
bio: I help business owners and founders build, manage, and improve the technology behind their work. That can mean a professional website, a custom software product, an organized support system, or an automation that removes repetitive tasks.
My approach connects product planning with hands-on delivery. We start with your business needs, agree what should change, and define the work and responsibilities before implementation.
You can engage for a specific project or agree ongoing care and product oversight. Every monthly agreement sets out covered work, capacity, and expectations so you know what support is included.

process.title: How We Work
process.description: Start with a clear need and an agreed scope. Build or improve the system, then choose a practical plan for handover or ongoing care.

steps.title: Understand the need
steps.description: Review your goals, current tools, customers, and the work that is taking too much time.

steps.title: Agree the scope
steps.description: Set out deliverables, responsibilities, review points, schedule, fees, and any third-party costs in a written proposal.

steps.title: Build or improve
steps.description: Implement the agreed website, software, support system, or automation with regular reviews.

steps.title: Launch and hand over
steps.description: Test the agreed scope, prepare launch, document the system, and explain how your team will use it.

steps.title: Maintain and review
steps.description: Choose optional ongoing care or product management with defined capacity, service hours, response expectations, and review points.

engagements.scopeTitle: How project delivery and ongoing care work
scopeItems: Project fees depend on the agreed scope, complexity, responsibilities, and review points. Third-party subscriptions and usage costs are identified separately.
All paid engagements require an approved written agreement or Statement of Work before work begins.
Monthly plans cover named systems and agreed tasks, capacity, service hours, response expectations, exclusions, and usage limits. Maintenance does not include unlimited development.
New features, additional workflows, emergency work, and support outside the agreement are separately scoped.
Customer support services cover support technology and workflows. Human support-agent staffing and round-the-clock customer-service coverage are excluded.

privacy.label: Legal draft — review required
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This draft explains how Efosa Ojomo Technology & Product Consulting may collect and use information submitted through this website. It must be reviewed and approved for the applicable business, jurisdiction, vendors, and data-retention practices before publication.

sections.title: Information you submit
sections.body: When you submit an inquiry or request a consultation, the site may collect your name, business email, company, website, requested service, project details, timeline, budget range, and consent record.

sections.title: How information may be used
sections.body: Information may be used to respond to inquiries, evaluate a potential engagement, schedule calls, provide requested services, maintain security, and measure website conversions where consent and applicable law permit.

sections.title: Service providers
sections.body: Production integrations may include a hosting provider, scheduling provider, email provider, database, and analytics provider. Their use must be configured and documented before launch.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Update this section with the approved business contact address and privacy-request process before publishing.

terms.label: Legal draft — review required
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: This draft describes the general terms for using this website and exploring consulting services. It is not final legal advice and must be reviewed by qualified counsel before production publication.

sections.title: Consulting engagements
sections.body: Specific scope, deliverables, fees, timelines, assumptions, confidentiality, intellectual property, and termination terms should be defined in a written proposal or agreement accepted by both parties.

sections.title: Advisory scope
sections.body: Unless a signed agreement says otherwise, content on this site is general information and does not guarantee a particular technical, financial, operational, or business outcome.

sections.title: Payments and scheduling
sections.body: Any paid workshop or fixed-price service must be governed by the approved proposal, invoice, and consulting agreement. Custom work and retainers should not be charged automatically without approval.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Update this section with the approved business contact address and governing-law language before publishing.
